pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular, dendritic geometries with sharp edge angularity and multiple acute protrusions; patches exhibit high spatial area variance between the neck and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex topological web of narrow, light-colored pathways; junction nodes are frequent and typically involve 3-5 converging corridors; pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck line, representing a short, stiff mane structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, dark, textured, multi-lobed protruding mass located on the posterior dorsal ridge near the rump, indicating significant localized structural pathology.
other_distinctive_markers: Extraordinarily fragmented 'oak-leaf' patch pattern characterized by deep incisions and high perimeter-to-area ratios.
